title: Relative free-parameter substitution and adjunction mates
statement: In the notation and categories of [def-sfb-free-parameter-evaluation-data], take the generator-normalized comparisons $G_P,G_{P'}$ of [lem-sfb-profinite-free-slice-derived-hom]. For any scheme $V$ and $V$-map $a:V[P']\to V[P]$, define $d_a$ by the representable-sheaf map induced by $a$, the existing local free-module functor, and $G_{P'}.\mathrm{freeIso}$ and $G_P.\mathrm{freeIso}^{-1}$. Define $H(a,-)$ by precomposition with $d_a[0]$ in the actual closed derived Hom. Define the direct-image parameter map as the projection-adjunction transpose of pullback of the projection counit, with the canonical pullback-composition maps. Define the base-change arrow for a commutative relative square in exactly the same way. The point parameter map is induced by the free functor on $h_j$ for $j:P'\to P$. The functor $P\mapsto\operatorname{Spec}C(P,\mathbb Z)$ preserves finite limits, since the locally constant integer algebra functor is a right adjoint [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-locally-constant-right-adjoint] and $\operatorname{Spec}$ is a right adjoint. For continuous $\alpha:Q\times P'\to P$, use its canonical product comparison to construct $a(q,p')=(q,\alpha(q,p'))$ over $V=X[Q]$; its structural projection is that of $V[P']$. Whenever the two specified $\beta$ maps are invertible, define the action on $F$ by $\beta_{\rm source};H(a,-);H_{P'}(v);\beta_{\rm target}^{-1}$ for every derived local coefficient arrow $v$. This construction uses neither $c$ nor its inverse.
